title: Stage Musical Adaptation of Webtoon The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family to Premiere in Seoul on March 24, 2027
content: Korean musical production company ShowNote announced on October 28 that its upcoming stage musical The Siren will run from March 24 to June 13, 2027, at the Charlotte Theater in Seoul. The musical is based on Sol Leesu's popular romance-fantasy web novel Siren: I Became a Contract Family with the Villain .
author: ANN

title: Omniscient Reader, Greatest Estate Developer, Debut or Die!, 7 More Works Win 2026 World Webtoon Awards
content: South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on November 3 the 10 main award winners of the 2026 World Webtoon Awards, including Omniscient Reader .
author: ANN

title: ATASHIn'CHI Next Net Anime's Additional Episodes Debut on January 1
content: Shinei Animation announced on Friday that the planned new episodes for ATASHIn'CHI Next , the latest net anime for the ATASHIn'CHI franchise, will debut on the franchise's YouTube channel on January 1 at 6:00 p.m. JST. New episodes will stream on the first Friday of every month at 6:00 p.m. JST.

title: 'Isekai Tensei Soudouki' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ryousen Takami 's Isekai Tensei Soudouki ( Multi-Mind Mayhem ) novel revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, a second key visual (pictured), and second promotional video on Friday.

title: CyberAgent Expands Production Network With Latent One Launch and MAPPA Partnership
content: CyberAgent is expanding its presence in Japan's animation industry through a combination of studio development and strategic investment, establishing a new animation studio under its subsidiary Colorful Palette while entering a business alliance with MAPPA .
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Draw This, Then Die!' Manga Takes 2-Month Break to Prepare for Final Arc
content: The December issue of Shogakukan 's Monthly Shonen Sunday ( Gessan ) magazine revealed on Thursday that Minoru Toyoda 's Draw This, Then Die! ( Kore Kaite Shine ) manga will take a hiatus for two months so that Toyoda can prepare for the final arc of the manga, as well as work on the manga's upcoming book volumes.
author: ANN

title: The F1 Japanese Grand Prix Names Cygames a Founding Partner
content: Cygames, Inc., Umamusume: Pretty Derby ‘s publisher, is now a founding partner of the 2027 FIA Formula 1 Lenovo Japanese Grand Prix. The partnership marks the first time that the F1 Japanese Grand Prix has had a founding partner.
author: Anime Corner
